title: Desk Reference: Make-Up Units for Late and Missed Rides in Prior Authorization Extension Requests
content:
A Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension request carries a make-up addition that counts the member's Non-Emergency Medical Transportation ride legs that were picked up late or at which the ride did not show, in the two months before the day of the request.

| Such ride legs in the two months before the request | Units added to the extension request |
|---|---|
| two or more | 2 |
| exactly one | 1 |
| none | 0 |

The legs counted are the member's Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trip legs recorded as picked up late, together with those recorded as a no-show on the ride's side, whose dates fall in the two months before the day of the request. A leg the member did not attend while the ride did show is not a leg at which the ride did not show. The addition is made once to the units the extension request asks for, before the floor of zero is applied.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- One leg picked up late and one leg at which the ride did not show, both within the two months: two legs, 2 units added.
- One late pickup within the two months and another three months before the request: one leg counts, 1 unit added.
- No late pickup and no ride no-show in the two months: nothing added.
